404.author: zy95-12
404.body:
Related: #339 (docs-only; keeps issue open — residual external picker). Related #352.

Folder import can work in a native browser while an external automation host rejects the same directory path. Add matching English and Chinese guidance to the existing Skills import guide so users can choose a complete-package alternative.

The note explains native Chromium `webkitdirectory` support, disabled Folder and ZIP/Git recovery in unsupported browsers (#352), and the remaining Scenario 2 Case A style host/driver limitation. It also identifies J11's successful directory `setInputFiles` coverage and explains that J11 is not blocked by that external picker gap. Only two Markdown files change.

Refs #339. Related: #352. This documentation follow-up leaves the external host limitation open.

## Validation

Candidate: `e54506e7`.

- `pnpm docs:check`: PASS, 141 Markdown files linted and checked for local links, 0 issues.
- `git diff --check`: PASS. Reviewed both translations against all five requested points and the existing J11 source.
- `pnpm ci:st`: PASS, 16 planned / 16 executed / 16 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped.
- `pnpm ci:ut`: blocked at `NON_ROOT_REQUIRED` preflight, 4,311 planned / 0 executed / 0 passed / 0 assertion failures / 0 skipped; the runner verdict is FAIL because nothing ran. The same layer on unmodified upstream main (`8811fcad`) reproduced the same preflight and counts in a separate worktree.
- `pnpm ci:e2e`: incomplete, 91 planned. The first research journey, AR-01 in `artifact-revision-mocked.spec.ts`, timed out at 180 seconds (0 passed, 1 observed failure). Stopped the remaining local run under memory pressure on this 3.4 GiB worker; no final aggregate counts were produced. A baseline E2E preparation attempt was also stopped before execution, so this timeout is not attributed as a proven upstream regression or a product regression.
- No product, UI, import pipeline, tests, or CI changes. No paid model tests were run.

## E2E user journeys

Not applicable to the change: these are documentation-only edits with no changed product path. The attempted full local browser layer is reported separately above and did not reach J11; no new J11 pass is claimed. The documented J11 behavior is supported by its existing source and the passing current-head CI evidence recorded in #352.

## Release

Release category: release:docs

User impact: clearer Folder compatibility and complete-package ZIP/Git alternatives.

Compatibility and migration: none.

404.title: docs(skills): clarify folder import browser and automation limits (#339)

407.author: zy95-12
407.body:
The Agent can now request direct host execution when the user asks to skip the sandbox or the Agent judges it unsuitable, including while the selected Runner's sandbox is ready. Sandbox remains the default preference. This follows up the recovery work from parent #276.

Refs #406. Parent: #276.

- Make `operation_id` optional and accept `runner_id` for direct consent without a preceding failed sandbox call. Recovery IDs still pin the Runner and reject mismatched targets.
- Remove the sandbox-unavailable precondition in both API scope validation and Runner submission. Unreachable Runners fail with user/network-administrator guidance; no SSH repair is added.
- Preserve separate `direct_code` permission, exact command/target/account/workspace/Agent-run scope, one-use authorization and a new submission call after approval. Sandbox Always Allow and chat text cannot authorize host execution.
- Update prompt/tool guidance and execution documentation. Extend binding, Runner HTTP and production API journey coverage.

## Validation

Tested commit: `78a43a9e4af3681c23c5a1199874165f2107e724` (rebased onto upstream main).

- Focused UT: **163 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped** (`direct-execution.test.ts`, `workspace-bindings.test.ts`, workspace and prompt tests).
- Build: `pnpm build` passed. Test TypeScript: `pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit` passed.
- Documentation lint and `git diff --check` passed.
- Full local UT/ST preparation was interrupted by worker termination. Full UT/ST/mocked browser E2E are not claimed as passing; the requested resume prioritizes targeted validation. GitHub Actions will provide the full PR gates.

## E2E user journeys

**PASS: 20/20 numbered steps across 2 journeys; 0 failed, 0 blocked, 0 skipped.**

Production API/Runner CLI entry points, native Agent backend, a local scripted model and separately configured loopback remote Runner; no paid model calls or SSH.

- `node test/api/direct-execution-journey.mjs --ready`: ready-sandbox direct selection without a preceding sandbox attempt; local/remote denial, allow-once and allow-matching; execution audit/logs/workspace output; lost acknowledgements and unreachable target.
- `node test/api/direct-execution-journey.mjs`: sandbox-unavailable recovery plus the same permission, audit and transport-failure cases.

## Release

Release category: release:feature
User impact: direct execution can be explicitly authorized before sandbox failure. Compatibility and migration: none; existing recovery requests remain supported.
407.head: feat/406-agent-first-direct
407.title: feat(execution): allow direct consent before sandbox failure
